rationale: The agent located the correct user and order, selected the bicycle item, and initiated a return to the original credit card, with final details (Mastercard ending 8484) consistent with the tool data. However, the agent executed an order-changing write (return_delivered_order_items) without first confirming the action with the user, which violates the stated policy requiring confirmation before any order-changing action. Authentication appears minimal but present (name + ZIP lookup and user details retrieval), and the action was on the user’s own order. Final information provided about the return and refund destination was supported by tools. Due to the missing confirmation step prior to submitting the return, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
